international.title: Black barrister tells of racist abuse after Rupert Lowe viral tweet
international.summary: Exclusive: Hard-right MP claimed photo featuring Joseph Ashong was sign of discrimination against white Britons A newly qualified black barrister who took part in a group photo that went viral after Rupert Lowe cited the image as evidence of discrimination against white Britons has said he has never before experienced such racism in the UK. Joseph Ashong, who was in a cohort attending their “call to the bar” ceremony in London, said he was amazed and upset by the reaction to the picture as it was viewed by millions on the afternoon of the ceremony.
